scope: Read-only frontend source audit of requirements 181 and 182; no application or shared-ledger edits

findings.confidence: confirmed source composition defect; browser reproduction pending
findings.finding: History formatWhen combines formatDate(iso), which preserves the raw ISO calendar date via a UTC-only calendar helper, with TIME_FORMAT.format(new Date(iso)), which uses browser-local time. Near midnight, the displayed date and time describe different days; no zone is displayed. For saved_at 2026-10-21T23:00:00Z in Asia/Kolkata the current composition is 21 Oct 2026, 04:30 while the local instant is 22 Oct 2026, 04:30.
findings.safe_frontend_proposal: Use the existing formatAuditTimestamp helper for saved-at history instants and restore-confirmation wording. Label Saved at clearly; retain Current badge, revision comparison, escaped text, compare direction and original saved_at. Do not introduce effective-date scheduling inputs: the version contract exposes saved_at, not an effective policy date.
bounded_tests: History fixtures at UTC/local midnight in Asia/Kolkata and America/Los_Angeles; same instant has coherent date/time and explicit zone.
Invalid/missing/unzoned values render existing truthful helper fallbacks and never prevent review.
Compare, close, restore confirmation cancel and exact original version-id request remain unchanged; restore mutations mocked.
Three-engine 320/1280 light/dark wrapping and axe for long explicit timezone text.

findings.confidence: source-backed responsive risk; no runtime occlusion proven
findings.finding: The sticky rr-dock can wrap save actions and variable status text, while the view reserves a fixed 120px bottom clearance. Its actual size is not measured here. This leaves final editor controls and validation text without a demonstrated clearance guarantee at narrow width, large text or long status messages. Existing grouped categories, summaries, unsaved markers and review/save flow should be preserved.
findings.safe_frontend_proposal: First reproduce with a long dirty editor and wrapped status/actions at 320px and large text. If overlap occurs, reserve actual dock height plus safe-area using scoped CSS custom property updated by ResizeObserver with disposal cleanup, or adopt a non-occluding layout. Keep submit/check/revision/draft behavior untouched.
bounded_tests: At 320x568 and 844x390 plus desktop, dirty one final duty field, expand final editor and scroll last input and validation message fully above actual dock bounding box.
Keyboard focus and elementFromPoint show final field and Review and save are visible and operable; compare before/after.
Wrap long status text and increase text to 200%; test light/dark and reduced motion.
Check stale 409 and invalid 422 review flows retain exact payload, draft, revision and no automatic mutation replay; mock writes.

limitations: Source audit only; no browser suites, build or hardware checks performed by this specialist.
No backend/API/calculation/permission/scheduling edits. No whole-requirement completion asserted.
Existing call-pool eligibility contract and known obsolete single-call-level test remain unchanged.
